items.source: In contrast to an Encoder which is a singleton and encodes any object of a given type, a View is typically selected by name and resolved using a ViewResolver which may for example match it to an HTML template. Furthermore a View may render based on multiple attributes contained in the model.
items.translation: 与作为单例并编码给定类型任何对象的Encoder不同，View通常通过名称选择并使用ViewResolver解析，该解析器可将其匹配到 HTML 模板等。此外，View可根据模型中包含的多个属性进行渲染。

items.source: A View can also choose to select an attribute from the model use any existing Encoder to render alternate media types.
items.translation: 一个 `View` 也可以选择从模型中选择一个属性，并使用任何现有的 `Encoder` 来渲染其他媒体类型。

items.source: Note: This attribute is not required and may not be present.
items.translation: 注意：此属性不是必需的，可能不存在。

items.source: The name of the exchange attribute that contains the BindingContext for the request which can be used to create BindingResult instances for objects in to the model.
items.translation: 包含请求的 `BindingContext` 的交换属性名称，该上下文可用于为模型中的对象创建 `BindingResult` 实例。

items.source: Return the list of media types this View supports, or an empty list.
items.translation: 返回该视图支持的媒体类型列表，或空列表。

items.source: Whether this View does render by performing a redirect.
items.translation: 该视图是否通过执行重定向进行渲染。

items.source: contentType - the content type selected to render with which should match one of the supported media types.
items.translation: `contentType` - 选定的用于渲染的内容类型，应与支持的媒体类型之一匹配。

items.source: Render the view based on the given HandlerResult.
items.translation: 根据给定的HandlerResult渲染视图。

items.source: Render the view based on the given HandlerResult. Implementations can access and use the model or only a specific attribute in it.
items.translation: 根据给定的HandlerResult渲染视图。实现可以访问并使用模型，或仅使用其中的特定属性。

items.source: model - a Map with name Strings as keys and corresponding model objects as values (Map can also be null in case of empty model)
items.translation: model - 一个以名称字符串为键、对应模型对象为值的 Map（若模型为空，该 Map 也可以为 null）

items.source: Mono to represent when and if rendering succeeds
items.translation: Mono 用于表示渲染何时以及是否成功。
